item.text: The bug is in shared permission resolution: `grantsFor` ignores parents, while downloads special-case analysts and skip explicit denials. I’ll resolve grants through the parent chain for every role and remove that bypass.

The fix now walks parent roles, guards against cycles, and leaves access decisions subject to explicit denials. I’ve added coverage for the auditor’s inherited grant and denial behavior; I’ll run the existing tests.
